home.name: Lab
home._roof_note: Ben 24 Oct: drone starts and lands on the roof of the Manufacturing Systems Engineering Lab (OSM way 58365864); home = roof centroid (moved 33 m W, 7 m S from 42.320278, -83.234139). alt_m = ground elevation; roof_m = roof height in the simulated world (OSM has no height tag: 8 m default). Altitudes in this file (cruise, transit, base) are above the ground at the call / above the pad for base; the pilot converts them.

_alt_note: cruise_alt_m = altitude at a call (inspection); transit_alt_m = agent altitude between calls, above building/tree tops (agent climbs first, descends vertically over the call).
